tagline.en: The Old Spanish Trail, from West Texas to the Atlantic
tagline.zh: 古西班牙之路，自西得州通向大西洋

start.en: Business Loop I-10, the old US 80, in Van Horn, Texas
start.zh: 得克萨斯州范霍恩，I-10 商业环线（旧 US 80）

end.en: Florida State Road A1A in Jacksonville Beach, three blocks from the Atlantic
end.zh: 佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔海滩，佛州 A1A 州道，距大西洋三个街区

en: US 90 is the southern coast-to-coast road that never quite reached either coast. It begins in Van Horn, in the West Texas desert, and runs southeast through Marfa, Alpine and the emptiness above the Big Bend to Del Rio on the Rio Grande, then east through San Antonio, Houston and the Louisiana bayou country to New Orleans. East of the city it becomes a beachfront road along the Mississippi Sound at Bay St. Louis, Gulfport and Biloxi, then works east through Mobile, Pensacola and Tallahassee to Jacksonville, ending three blocks short of the Atlantic at Jacksonville Beach.

Because I-10 was built alongside it for almost its entire length, US 90 now functions at two speeds. In Louisiana between Lafayette and New Orleans it is a divided industrial corridor that the state is progressively converting to interstate standards as I-49 South; across north Florida and much of Texas it is the old two-lane road through the main streets of towns the Interstate bypassed, and in places it is the local business route of the freeway that replaced it.
zh: US 90 是那条从未真正抵达两岸的南方横贯公路。它起于西得克萨斯沙漠中的范霍恩，东南行经马尔法、阿尔派恩与大弯地区以北的空旷之地，至格兰德河畔的德尔里奥，再东行经圣安东尼奥、休斯敦与路易斯安那的沼泽地带抵新奥尔良。出城以东，它成为密西西比湾沿岸的海滨道路，经圣路易斯湾、格尔夫波特与比洛克西，随后东行经莫比尔、彭萨科拉与塔拉哈西至杰克逊维尔，在杰克逊维尔海滩离大西洋仅三个街区处终止。
由于 I-10 几乎全程与之并行修建，US 90 如今以两种速度运转。在路易斯安那的拉斐特至新奥尔良之间，它是一条分隔式的工业走廊，州政府正逐步将其升级为州际公路标准、即 I-49 南段；而在佛罗里达北部与得克萨斯的大部分路段，它仍是那条穿过被州际公路绕开的小镇主街的旧双车道公路，有些地方甚至成了取代它的那条高速公路的地方商业环线。

en: The road's identity predates its number. The Old Spanish Trail Association formed in Mobile, Alabama, in 1915 to promote a southern transcontinental highway from St. Augustine, Florida, to San Diego, California, trading on the Spanish and French colonial history of the Gulf Coast towns along the way. The Texas Highway Commission adopted most of the route in 1917 as State Highway 3, calling it the Southern National Highway; the association moved its headquarters to San Antonio in 1919, and in March 1924 dedicated a Zero Milestone in front of San Antonio's City Hall to mark the trail's approximate midpoint. In 1929 it declared the road complete, dedicated a monument at St. Augustine, and effectively wound up.

The federal numbering of 1926 imposed US 90 on the eastern half of that trail, from the Louisiana line near Orange to Van Horn, where it met US 80. The Texas Historical Commission puts the Old Spanish Trail's Texas length at roughly 900 miles, much of it now buried under I-10. The number's ends have barely moved since: a northward extension along what is now TX 54 to US 62 near Guadalupe Pass lasted less than a year from 1939, and in 1950 the eastern end was pushed from Jacksonville out to Jacksonville Beach, where it remains.
zh: 这条路的身份早于它的号码。1915 年，古西班牙之路协会在亚拉巴马州莫比尔成立，旨在推动一条自佛罗里达州圣奥古斯丁至加利福尼亚州圣迭戈的南方横贯公路，并借沿线墨西哥湾各城镇的西班牙与法国殖民历史作为招牌。得克萨斯州公路委员会 1917 年把这条路线的大部分采纳为 3 号州道，称之为「南方国道」；协会 1919 年把总部迁至圣安东尼奥，并于 1924 年 3 月在圣安东尼奥市政厅前立起一座「零里程碑」，标示该路线的大致中点。1929 年，协会宣布道路建成，在圣奥古斯丁立碑，随后实际停止运作。

1926 年的联邦编号把 US 90 加在这条古道的东半段上：自奥兰治附近的路易斯安那州界至范霍恩，在那里与 US 80 相接。得克萨斯历史委员会认为古西班牙之路在得州境内约长 900 英里，其中大部分如今埋在 I-10 之下。此后这个号码的两端几乎没有移动过：1939 年起沿今日 TX 54 向北延伸至瓜达卢佩山口附近 US 62 的做法不足一年即告终；1950 年东端自杰克逊维尔推至杰克逊维尔海滩，沿用至今。

en: The most expensive work ever done on US 90 was disaster repair. Hurricane Katrina's storm surge on 29 August 2005 destroyed both of the route's Mississippi bay crossings. The Mississippi Department of Transportation issued a request for proposals for a replacement at St. Louis Bay just over two months later and awarded its first major design-build contract five months after the storm; the 2.1-mile bridge between Pass Christian and Bay St. Louis cost about $267 million, opened two lanes to traffic in May 2007 and was finished the following January. The Biloxi Bay crossing to Ocean Springs, a $338.6 million design-build project, opened one lane each way in November 2007 and was complete 22 months after notice to proceed.

The continuing expense is the Louisiana upgrade. The state's Geaux South programme would convert roughly 160 miles of US 90 between Lafayette and New Orleans into I-49; more than 100 miles were finished or under construction by 2013, and a 2013 departmental review cut the estimated cost of the remaining work substantially — for example reducing a 36-mile section in Lafourche, St. Charles and Jefferson parishes from $4.8 billion to $1.3 billion. Work continues piecemeal, the current example being a $136.5 million grade-separated interchange at Ambassador Caffery Parkway in Lafayette.
zh: US 90 上造价最高的工程是灾后重建。2005 年 8 月 29 日，卡特里娜飓风的风暴潮摧毁了本路线在密西西比州的两处海湾跨越工程。密西西比州交通运输部在风暴过后两个多月即发出圣路易斯湾替代桥梁的招标书，并在灾后五个月授出该州首个重大设计—施工总承包合同；这座连接帕斯克里斯琴与圣路易斯湾、长 2.1 英里的桥梁造价约 2.67 亿美元，2007 年 5 月开放两条车道通行，次年 1 月全部完工。通往海洋泉的比洛克西湾跨越工程为一项 3.386 亿美元的设计—施工总承包项目，2007 年 11 月双向各开放一条车道，自开工通知起 22 个月完工。

持续性的开支来自路易斯安那的升级改造。该州的「Geaux South」计划要把拉斐特至新奥尔良之间约 160 英里的 US 90 改建为 I-49；到 2013 年已有 100 多英里完工或在建，而该部门 2013 年的一次复核大幅削减了余下工程的估价——例如把拉福什、圣查尔斯与杰斐逊三教区内一段 36 英里路段的估价由 48 亿美元降至 13 亿美元。工程仍在分段推进，眼下的例子是拉斐特市 Ambassador Caffery 大道处一座造价 1.365 亿美元的立体交叉工程。

label.zh: 2006—08 年圣路易斯湾桥梁重建

value.en: About $267 million for a 2.1-mile design-build replacement, federally funded and owned by the Mississippi DOT
value.zh: 约 2.67 亿美元，为一座 2.1 英里的设计—施工总承包替代桥梁，由联邦出资、密西西比州交通运输部拥有

figures.source: HNTB, Granite Construction and Walsh Construction, 'Design/Build of US-90 Replacement Bridge over St. Louis Bay', PCI National Bridge Conference, 2007; Engineering News-Record, October 2007

label.zh: 2006—08 年比洛克西湾桥梁重建

value.en: $338.6 million design-build contract for a 1.6-mile bay bridge within a 2.4-mile project
value.zh: 3.386 亿美元的设计—施工总承包合同，在 2.4 英里的项目范围内建成 1.6 英里的跨湾桥梁

figures.source: Parsons and GC Constructors, 'US 90 Bridge over Biloxi Bay', PCI National Bridge Conference, 2007

label.zh: 路易斯安那 I-49 南段改建

value.en: A roughly 160-mile programme, Lafayette to New Orleans, with more than 100 miles complete or under construction as of 2013; the active Ambassador Caffery interchange contract is $136.5 million
value.zh: 自拉斐特至新奥尔良、约 160 英里的整体计划，至 2013 年已有 100 多英里完工或在建；在建的 Ambassador Caffery 立交合同金额为 1.365 亿美元

figures.source: Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development, I-49 South announcement, December 2013, and Ambassador Caffery project update, August 2025

why.en: No such figure exists. US 90 was numbered in 1926 over roads eight states had already built, and its later works have been funded project by project.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。US 90 于 1926 年沿 8 个州已建成的道路编号，此后的工程均按项目分别筹资。

why.en: Traffic is counted by each state and varies by more than an order of magnitude along the route, from a six-lane suburban corridor in Louisiana to a desert two-lane in West Texas. No combined figure is published.
why.zh: 交通量由各州分别统计，且沿线差异超过一个数量级——从路易斯安那的六车道郊区走廊到西得克萨斯的沙漠双车道。并无合并数字发布。

why.en: Condition data are reported to the Federal Highway Administration by state and functional class rather than by U.S. Route number, so no route-level rating exists for US 90.
why.zh: 路况数据按州与功能等级、而非按美国国道编号上报联邦公路管理局，因此不存在针对 US 90 的全线评级。

timeline.en: The Old Spanish Trail Association is organised in Mobile, Alabama, to promote a St. Augustine–San Diego highway.
timeline.zh: 古西班牙之路协会在亚拉巴马州莫比尔成立，推动修建圣奥古斯丁至圣迭戈的公路。

timeline.en: Texas adopts most of the route as State Highway 3, calling it the Southern National Highway.
timeline.zh: 得克萨斯把该路线的大部分采纳为 3 号州道，称之为「南方国道」。

timeline.en: A Zero Milestone is dedicated at San Antonio's City Hall marking the trail's approximate midpoint.
timeline.zh: 圣安东尼奥市政厅前立起「零里程碑」，标示该路线的大致中点。

timeline.en: The federal numbering makes the eastern half of the trail US 90, from near Orange, Texas, to Van Horn.
timeline.zh: 联邦编号把这条古道的东半段定为 US 90，自得克萨斯州奥兰治附近至范霍恩。

timeline.en: The Old Spanish Trail Association declares the road complete and dedicates a monument at St. Augustine.
timeline.zh: 古西班牙之路协会宣布道路建成，并在圣奥古斯丁立碑。

timeline.en: The eastern terminus is extended from Jacksonville to Jacksonville Beach.
timeline.zh: 东端终点自杰克逊维尔延伸至杰克逊维尔海滩。

timeline.en: Hurricane Katrina destroys the route's bridges over St. Louis Bay and Biloxi Bay.
timeline.zh: 卡特里娜飓风摧毁本路线跨越圣路易斯湾与比洛克西湾的桥梁。

timeline.en: Both replacement bridges open to traffic, the St. Louis Bay crossing in May and Biloxi Bay in November.
timeline.zh: 两座重建桥梁通车：圣路易斯湾段于 5 月，比洛克西湾段于 11 月。
